notes.title: New Update #2 - V1.3.3 - Volume Control And Auto-save
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I am glad to notify you that I have finally introduced some important features into this game with a little modification in the "Game Menu".

I have successfully added some of the great features which were missing in the previous versions of NightmareZ and special thanks to all the people who have provided constructive feedback and supported me to improve this game project.

[b]Features Added in V1.3.3 :[/b]
- [b]Added in-game Volume controls:[/b] This is a feature which most of the people asked me to work on. So, I have finally added in-game Volume Control in "Controls" menu. In this case, you need to press 'N' key to reduce the volume level and press 'M' key to increase the volume level. Moreover, the volume levels can be adjusted during the gameplay too. That means, you can control the volume level by pressing the same two keys even when you are playing the levels. [b]Please note that, changes to the volume control will be effective for the current session only and it requires to be adjusted again when you run the game next time. [/b]

-[b]Added Auto-save Feature:[/b] In the previous version, I have added save and load feature. But from now on, the game will be saved automatically at the beginning of each level except a few special levels where the checkpoint is easily accessible. You can collect checkpoint balls to save the levels too.

-[b]Added Cursor key movements including WASD movement:[/b] From now on, you can control the player both with WASD controls and cursor keys. This feature has been added because some people like to use cursor keys for player's movement instead of WASD controls. Having both the features is necessary and hence, added.

-[b]Escape button "Exit":[/b] The Pause menu has not been completely done yet. In the previous version, if you accidentally pressed "Esc" button while playing the game you used to lose all the gameplay progress. So, in order to stop this from happening, the game progress will be auto-saved even if you accidentally press "Esc" key to exit the game. That means, the game will be saved automatically before it takes you to the "Main Menu screen" in this version.

This is all about the latest version V1.3.3 which has been released today. However, a new version will be available with a capability of taking in-game screenshots and adding more options in the pause menu with some added features here and there. Thank you very much for your patience!

Special thanks to everyone who have tried out the game and your feedback helped me to improve the game. I hope that I would be able to add the remaining features very soon. Thanks for your continuous support guys!

[b]Note to existing customers: You should get a new update notification in your Steam client. It is hereby requested that you download the latest version if you want "Volume Control and Auto-save" features to be enabled in your game.[/b]

Best Regards,
Anamik

notes.title: New Update #1 - V1.3.2 - Save and Load Feature
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I am glad to notify you that I have finally introduced saving and loading feature into this game but in a different manner. The player will be given two or three saving areas in each level. I have introduced it considering its importance in a platform game.

This save feature will act as a "Checkpoint" which can be loaded again at any time after the game ends. The saved levels can only be loaded from the "Main Menu". The player will have to collide with the "Green glowy ball" in order to save the level and it's pretty easy. The checkpoints are placed in the levels appropriately. The player will also receive a message "Game Saved" when collecting them.

You will come to know about this feature when you play the latest build which has been uploaded today.

[b]Note to existing customers: You should get a new update notification in your Steam client. It is hereby requested that you download the latest version if you want "Save and Load" feature to be enabled in your game.[/b]

I will release more updates based on the community feedback and suggestions. I hope you will enjoy the game!

Thanks! If you have queries, feel free to ask me. 

Best Regards,
Anamik
